nodes.label: Capability section (four compact cards)
nodes.rationale: Reduced from four dense prose cards to one-line summaries with six tool chips each, linking to the Skills tab.

nodes.label: Proof strip CountUp
nodes.rationale: Final values are rendered first so nothing is lost if JS or animation fails; latency (<150ms) deliberately static.

nodes.label: Hero backdrop canvas dot grid (HeroBackdrop.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Pauses offscreen/in background tabs, draws one static frame under prefers-reduced-motion, and is masked so it never sits behind text at full strength.

nodes.label: No added animation libraries decision
nodes.rationale: GSAP, Lenis, Vanta, ShaderGradient, React Three Fiber and liquid glass were considered and not used: CSS plus one 2D canvas covers the design with no extra bundle weight.

nodes.label: Kinetic headline RotatingWord (HeroMotion.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Screen readers get 'systems' only; rotation off under reduced motion; reserves the width of its longest word.

nodes.label: Cursor garage defaults (drift-garage-v3)
nodes.rationale: Settings key bumped because every visit saves the settings, so a new key is the only way new defaults reach returning visitors.

nodes.label: Interface sounds (useUiSounds.ts, SoundToggle.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Eight front-end effects at 30% volume mapped to kinds of action; hover sounds mouse-only and throttled; no background music.

nodes.label: graphify update (AST-only refresh)
